title: Whole Charred Hakka Ground Beef Buddha Jumps Over Wall
description: A charred and shattering date-night Chinese dish featuring ground beef in a miso marinade, Whole30-friendly and served in a Buddha Jumps Over Wall form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, coconut aminos, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the ground beef to the marinade and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Transfer the beef mixture to a parchment-lined baking sheet and shape into a Buddha Jumps Over Wall form.
Bake for 25 minutes, then broil for an additional 2-3 minutes to achieve a charred exterior.
Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped scallions.
Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
